definition: Unique patient_id rows in harmonized_modeling_dataframe.csv after report cohort filtering.
Unique coord-level units in source_presence_all.csv. These are TMA cores for NAC2020/PURE01/No-NAC and whole-section regions for BLASST.
Unit appears in the QC source-presence universe for AR/BT panels.
Unit has all primary inputs according to qc_check.py: cells/parquet, tissue, clinical, and for TMA cohorts manual review; BLASST does not require review.
OS_event == 1 among patients with OS_event and at least one OS time column.
REC == 1 among patients with REC and at least one recurrence time column.
cT parsed as T3/T4 or numeric 3/4 among evaluable cT values.
pT parsed as pT0/0 among evaluable pT values.
pN parsed as N+, N1-N3, or numeric >0 among evaluable pN values.
